stories.title: Lumiere Labs launches $38 vitamin C serum at Sephora
stories.summary: Lumiere Labs has put its first vitamin C serum on sale at Sephora, priced at $38. Several outlets say stock is limited for now, and a rollout to Middle East stores has started too.

stories.title: Aurelia Group to acquire Marlowe Skin
stories.summary: Aurelia Group is buying the skincare brand Marlowe Skin. No financial terms were given, though one trade outlet reads the move as a way for Aurelia to build out its skincare range.

stories.title: Cosmo Expo Dubai 2026 opens with 400 brands
stories.summary: Cosmo Expo Dubai has opened with around 400 brands taking part. Fragrance and skincare drew most of the attention on the first day.

stories.title: Dune Beauty recalls SPF 50 stick after contamination finding
stories.summary: Dune Beauty is pulling a batch of its SPF 50 sunscreen sticks after a possible bacterial contamination was found. Anyone who owns one is told to stop using the affected lots.

stories.title: Anyone else obsessed with this $9 lip oil from Petal & Pine?
stories.summary: A Reddit post about a $9 Petal & Pine lip oil is one of the day's top posts in a skincare community, with people sharing whether they like it.

stories.title: Petal & Pine mascara drops to £12 in early Black Friday sale
stories.summary: Petal & Pine's lengthening mascara is down to £12 as the brand starts its Black Friday sale early. The discount runs until Sunday, according to The Powder Room.

stories.title: Sunscreen recall roundup for October
stories.summary: This roundup collects the sunscreen recalls announced during October, in one list.

stories.title: My honest review of the Marlowe Skin barrier cream
stories.summary: A blogger tried the barrier cream from Marlowe Skin for two weeks on dry cheeks and writes up how it went.

stories.title: How to layer retinol and niacinamide without irritation
stories.summary: A dermatologist explains how to combine retinol and niacinamide in one routine, covering the order to apply them and how far apart to use them to keep irritation down.
